subject.title: fix(cron): bound cron quarantine sidecar file reads

question: Should repeated cron quarantine overflows retain only the five newest archived sidecars, or should recovery preserve older quarantined records through a different bounded and visible policy?
rationale: The PR changes persistent recovery data from unbounded retention to silent pruning; code review cannot determine the acceptable loss and operator-recovery contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve bounded five-archive retention
options.body: Keep the current five-file policy, but make the pruning and recovery outcome explicitly visible in the relevant diagnostic path and prove it on the final head.

options.title: Use a different bounded recovery design
options.body: Replace silent archive deletion with a maintainer-selected bounded store, export path, or explicit operator-facing cleanup contract.

options.title: Limit this PR to read/write caps
options.body: Defer archive-and-fresh-write recovery until the persisted quarantine retention contract is designed separately.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded five-archive retention
recommendation.body: Keep the current five-file policy, but make the pruning and recovery outcome explicitly visible in the relevant diagnostic path and prove it on the final head.

likelyOwner.reason: The available timeline provides the only human routing signal; local ownership history could not be inspected.
